ValidationRule.description: Requires completion of all necessary fields on the system access page layout.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Support_Type__c, "Read-Only Access Request"), $Profile.Name=="Eligibility Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name=="Fiscal Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name=="Provider Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name=="Universal User", $Profile.Name== "CCCAP Program Internal Team", $Profile.Name=="System Administrator", $Profile.Name=="System Admin", $Profile.Name=="CHATS System Administrator", OR( ISBLANK(Email_Address__c), ISBLANK(Last_Name__c), ISBLANK(First_name__c), ISBLANK(Phone_Number__c), ISBLANK(Start_Deactivation_Change_Date__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Is_this_staff_member_replacing_another__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Access_Level_Requested__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For a Read-Only Access Request, Please ensure the following fields have been completed: Start Date; First Name; Last Name; Email Address; Profile Name; Phone #; Is this staff member replacing another.
